reviews.review: played it on the xbox when it first came out. just recently bought it and played it again. One of the few Warhammer games that does this universe Justice 10/10
great game for fans and anyone interested in warhammer cannon.

Quite an entertaining game in the 40K setting. Good graphics, setting, sounds and gameplay.

Pretty short (Finished in ~10 hours) and would benefit from longer content, more enemies and larger scale (You're usually in a 3 man squad or on your own)

Wouldn't recommend at full price. Get it in a sale.
AWESOME GAME! True to Warhammer story thats full of action and easy to learn and have fun with. FOR THE EMPEROR!!!

I’ll break this review down by Environment, Story, and Gameplay.
Environment: I don’t know anything about Warhammer 40,000, but the world and character design in this game really give you a sense of what this universe is like. I found myself several times just looking around at how cool the backdrops are and how massive everything is. The graphics are very solid and I found little glitching, leading to a rich aura as you slaughter everything evil. Super polished and immersive. 9/10

Story: The story seemed to be divided into two halves; the first slow half and the second intriguing half. The story in the first half of the game seemed to be dragging, but once it hits a certain point it defiantly makes you want to keep playing to see how it all concludes. The characters seemed to be really cool and gave you insight into the whole attitude of the ultra-marines. The villains and Orcs are done well enough and the story seem to have a solid twist. 7/10

Gameplay: This was by far the game’s biggest blight. I loved the violence and gore that you are able to achieve threw hack and slash play, but they entire first half of the game is simply that. There is little variation from this model which makes the game get very tiresome after the first 30 minutes. Coupled with a dry first half of the storyline, the game is kind of challenging to keep playing. I was defiantly board after the first hour. The game also seems to have a very limited number of enemies. Later in the game, you can defiantly tell you’re fighting reskinned versions of early sprites with maybe a tweak. With the addition of more weapons, the game does get some variety in tactical gameplay, but I kind of felt like it was too little too late. 4/10

Overall, I’d give the game a solid B-. The story is ok, environment is beautiful, but play is boring a repetitive. If you’re a 40k fan, Id say you’ll love it, but for a normal gamer I’d only pick this up if you like just slaughtering everything in melee combat.
